newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica Telkom signing delayed few hrs - SBC.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica Telkom signing delayed few hrs - SBC.

text.p: The official signing of South Africa's landmark Telkom privatisation deal had been delayed a few hours due to technical delays, an SBC Communications Inc spokesman said on Wednesday.
"We have agreement in principle but the document is not expected to be signed until later today," SBC spokesman Larry Solomon said by telephone from the U.S.
Under the deal SBC and Telekom Malaysia Bhd will take a 30 percent stake in the state utility for $1.261 billion.
Details of the agreement were announced earlier on Wednesday by the South African government.
